advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Decide how an alias-shaped reason that resolves to no ticket is handled (e.g. a resolvable-id check at lint time, or a narrower alias grammar) so a prose fragment cannot pose as a permanent sunset admission.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/sunset_markers.py:29: `_SUNSET_RE = re.compile(rf"^({_QUAD}(?:-{_QUAD}){{3}}|{_QUAD}-{_QUAD}|[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+){{2}})\b")`

sunset_ticket docstring: 'A well-formed id naming no existing ticket passes here; the close precheck is what gives the id its meaning.' — but a close is only held open for tickets that resolve; an alias-shaped fragment that resolves to nothing is never discharged by any close.
_names_ticket returns False for an alias resolving to None (resolve_ticket_id(...) == resolved_id is False), so such a marker blocks no close and lives forever.
advisory.finding: The store-free alias shape `[a-z]+(?:-[a-z]+){2}` accepts any three-word lowercase-hyphenated prose fragment (e.g. 'fix-the-bug', 'remove-after-merge') as a 'sunset ticket'. Such a reason passes the lint-time ratchet but names no resolvable ticket, so the close precheck never holds any close open for it — restoring the permanent admission the change exists to retire, now disguised as a well-formed id.
scenarios: An author writes '# mechanism-ok: lock foo — remove-after-launch temporary workaround'; the ratchet admits it and no close ever refuses, so the mechanism is admitted permanently.

advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Share the reason-extraction parser (not just the id regex) between sunset_markers.py and scripts/_mechanism_delta/markers.py so the two halves cannot diverge on how a marker's reason is located.
evidence: src/rebar/_commands/sunset_markers.py:51-66 `marker_reason` and scripts/_mechanism_delta/markers.py:52-68 `_split_name_reason` contain the same `_NAME_REASON_RE.search` + separator-strip logic implemented separately.
sunset_markers.py docstring lines 9-12 assert single-sourcing prevents drift, but the ratchet imports only `sunset_ticket`, not the reason parser.
advisory.finding: Marker reason-extraction logic is duplicated: `marker_reason` in sunset_markers.py reimplements the same separator/name-split logic as `_split_name_reason`/`parse_marker` in scripts/_mechanism_delta/markers.py. Only `sunset_ticket` (the id regex) is imported/shared, so the module's claim that 'both halves read the grammar from HERE so they cannot drift apart' holds only for the id shape, not for how the reason field is located.
scenarios: A future edit to the accepted separators or name/reason splitting is made in one module only; the ratchet and the close precheck then disagree on which text is the 'reason', so a marker can parse differently at lint time vs close time.

advisory.finding: The newly added `--force` bypass of the sunset-marker refusal is untested. close_precheck.py returns early on `force_close` (lines 646-649) BEFORE `_refuse_open_sunset_marker` runs (line 666), and the diff's comment states 'Only an explicit --force (handled above) passes it.'
